finding: LibreCAD's bundled MPOLYGON writer rejects boundaries it cannot project to polylines, while upstream retains extended edge paths useful to other consumers. A single unconditional behavior would discard one of these compatibility requirements.
change: Add an opt-in typed MPOLYGON polyline-only DXF writer policy. Default retains extended edge-path output. The selected policy is snapped once per whole-file write and changes made in callbacks apply to the next write.
verification: ASCII and Binary tests cover strict rejection of a gapped loop with destination preservation, same-writer retry with extended mode, subsequent strict refusal, and corrected line/arc projection.
Existing nonempty polyline succeeds and an empty polyline is refused without replacing the previous output.
Callback-time changes in both directions are applied on the next whole-file write.
Adjacent HATCH and default MPOLYGON controls pass, and independent ezdxf arc reconstruction remains green.
On the local AppleClang build sizeof(dxfRW) is 4576 both before and after; this alone is not an ABI qualification.
limits: The local LibreCAD adapter and focused tests pass both linked builds; this is not a current-head integration or complete application qualification.
The setting affects only typed writeMPolygon calls; raw replay, native rendering and other MPOLYGON fields are not covered.
Mixed-edge full-circle projection and broader consumer/platform and ABI qualification remain open.
No DWG or DXF fixture files were added.
